spans.s: luḍati (= Pali luḷati, trans. and intrans.), intrans. stirs, moves, is agitated: LV 〔308.4〕 (vs) vṛkṣa (n. pl.) luḍanti. Cf. luḍita.

luḍita, adj. (pple. of luḍati, q.v.; = Pali luḷita; cf. [] Skt. lulita, loḍita; see also a-luḍita), agitated, sometimes physically: Gv 〔202.21〕, of water, stirred by perfumed breeze; Sukh 〔38.1〕 (nadyaḥ …) nānāratna-luḍita-puṣpasaṃghāta-vāhinyo; oftener intellectually, Laṅk 〔285.5〕, with citta; Gv 〔338.4〕 ˚ta-saṃtānaiḥ (see saṃtāna, which here = citta); Mvy 〔6819〕.
